programs.rightsClaimSummary: Axsome 2026 Form 10-Q discloses patent rights for AUVELITY/AXS-05 licensed from Antecip, an entity owned by its CEO/Chair, including ongoing royalties and related-party potential conflicts. Its 2025 Form 10-K details proprietary AXS-05 formulation and patents. Neither disclosure independently adjudicates perpetual unencumbered legal rights.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Axsome Aug. 10, 2026 Form 10-Q describes 2012 exclusive Antecip licensed patents used by AXS-05/AUVELITY, royalty obligations, CEO-owned related party conflict.
Axsome full-year 2025 SEC Form 10-K describes proprietary AXS-05 formulation and intellectual property portfolio, originally approved for MDD in 2022 and researched for Alzheimer agitation.
Axsome Dec. 31, 2025 SEC-filed release reported FDA accepted AD agitation supplemental NDA, priority review, PDUFA target April 30, 2026; THIS DATE IS HISTORICAL AND COMPLETED.

FDA April 30, 2026 press announcement confirms AUVELITY expanded approval for adult dementia due to Alzheimer's disease agitation; names supporting trials NCT03226522 and NCT04947553. This is a completed FDA decision, not upcoming review.
ADVANCE trial original AXS-05 Alzheimer agitation Phase 2/3. FDA explicitly names the study as a randomized supporting trial in Apr 30 press release.
ACCORD withdrawal trial of AXS-05 for Alzheimer agitation. Not one of two trial NCTs explicitly named in FDA Apr 30 news release.
ACCORD-2 longer trial AXS-05 for Alzheimer agitation; FDA explicitly names it as randomized supporting trial in April 30 news release.
AXS-05-AD-305 open-label extension stopped after study program objectives; separate safety follow-up, not separately FDA-approved clinical indication.

officialFdaHistoricalAction.indication: Agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer's disease in adults

programs.rightsClaimSummary: Axsome August 2026 Form 10-Q describes January 2020 exclusive US license from Pfizer to reboxetine clinical/nonclinical data and intellectual property for AXS-12, with Pfizer regulatory/sales milestones, tiered royalties, and a right of first negotiation for strategic transactions. This is issuer disclosure, not independent contract adjudication or a claim of unrestricted worldwide commercialization rights.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Axsome Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports Pfizer January 2020 exclusive U.S. reboxetine clinical/nonclinical data and IP license; future milestones/royalties and first negotiation rights; AXS-12 NDA filing acceptance and reported May 1, 2027 PDUFA. This filing is issuer disclosure, not independent license contract evaluation.

July 15, 2026 Axsome SEC-filed press release reports FDA accepted AXS-12 NDA for cataplexy in narcolepsy, assigned May 1, 2027 PDUFA, and no advisory committee currently planned, all attributed to issuer rather than FDA-issued action letter.
2025 Form 10-K reports positive SYMPHONY and ENCORE AXS-12 trial results and Pfizer exclusive U.S. reboxetine data/IP license.
Original NCT05059223 Phase 3 SYMPHONY study compares AXS-12 with placebo for cataplexy in narcolepsy.
Original NCT05113745 Phase 3 ENCORE long-term randomized withdrawal and safety study of AXS-12 for narcolepsy.

trialLinks.indication: Long-term efficacy and safety of AXS-12 for cataplexy and excessive daytime sleepiness in narcolepsy

limitations: This evidence combines primary SEC filing descriptions of related-party Antecip IP licenses, original registered NCT identities and official FDA April 30, 2026 label-expansion approval for AUVELITY. FDA expressly names two supporting trial identifiers. The FDA decision and issuer-reported April 30 PDUFA target are PAST/COMPLETE, not a 2026-10-26 upcoming decision. Neither FDA approval nor IP issuer disclosure independently adjudicates all modern contracts or PDUFA target for future applications. Research only; no auto Pipeline promotion. Separate AXS-12 narcolepsy accepted NDA/PDUFA date May 1, 2027 is issuer-reported in July 2026 SEC-filed announcement and Q2 2026 Form 10-Q; not direct FDA goal-date letter verification. Pfizer license carries royalties, milestones and negotiation rights. AXS-12 SYMPHONY and ENCORE share one NDA event rather than two separate PDUFA dates.
